name: lerobot
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.7.0"
  build_number: 2
  # patch_py311_compat.patch backports PEP 695 syntax and itertools.batched
  # so that the package remains usable with Python 3.11.
  python_min: "3.11"
  # Fast CPU tests using local fixtures: cameras, config/CLI parsing, RNG state,
  # legacy gRPC and current remote protocol, JSON I/O, feature validation,
  # synthetic MP4 streaming, PushT compatibility, and learning-rate schedules.
  representative_tests: >-
    tests/cameras/test_opencv.py
    tests/configs/test_plugin_loading.py
    tests/scripts/test_edit_dataset_parsing.py
    tests/utils/test_random_utils.py
    tests/transport/test_transport_utils.py
    tests/transport/test_protocol_codec.py
    tests/transport/test_protocol_envelope.py
    tests/utils/test_io_utils.py
    tests/utils/test_feature_spec.py
    tests/test_streaming_compact.py
    tests/envs/test_envs.py::test_factory[pusht]
    tests/envs/test_envs.py::test_env[pusht-PushT-v0-state]
    tests/optim/test_schedulers.py

recipe:
  name: lerobot-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/huggingface/lerobot/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: f1f3749ba9cf24f5e6ff0df71be4f267ac5193b09b0eb1a7ebb27301c5597588
    patches:
      - patch_pypi_deps_metadata.patch
      - patch_py311_compat.patch

    sha256: 9dc9df05797dc0e7b92edc845caab2e4c37c3cfcabb4ee6339c67212b5baba3b
    target_directory: tests/artifacts/cameras
  - url: https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/huggingface/lerobot/v${{ version }}/tests/artifacts/cameras/image_160x120.png
    sha256: 7e11af87616b83c1cdb30330e951b91e86b51c64a1326e1ba5b4a3fbcdec1a11
    target_directory: tests/artifacts/cameras
  - url: https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/huggingface/lerobot/v${{ version }}/tests/artifacts/cameras/image_320x180.png
    sha256: b8840fb643afe903191248703b1f95a57faf5812ecd9978ac502ee939646fdb2

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  noarch: python

outputs:
  - package:
      name: lerobot
    build:
      script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install .
      python:
        entry_points:
          - lerobot-build-mp4-sidecar = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_build_mp4_sidecar:main
          - lerobot-calibrate = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_calibrate:main
          - lerobot-find-cameras = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_find_cameras:main
          - lerobot-find-port = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_find_port:main
          - lerobot-record = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_record:main
          - lerobot-replay = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_replay:main
          - lerobot-setup-motors = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_setup_motors:main
          - lerobot-teleoperate = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_teleoperate:main
          - lerobot-convert-dcp = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_convert_dcp:main
          - lerobot-env-server = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_env_server:main
          - lerobot-eval = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_eval:main
          - lerobot-train = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_train:main
          - lerobot-train-tokenizer = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_train_tokenizer:main
          - lerobot-dataset-viz = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_dataset_viz:main
          - lerobot-info = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_info:main
          - lerobot-find-joint-limits = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_find_joint_limits:main
          - lerobot-imgtransform-viz = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_imgtransform_viz:main
          - lerobot-edit-dataset = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_edit_dataset:main
          - lerobot-setup-can = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_setup_can:main
          - lerobot-annotate = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_annotate:main
          - lerobot-rollout = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_rollout:main
          - lerobot-policy-server = lerobot.scripts.lerobot_policy_server:main

    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        - setuptools
        - pip
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - huggingface_hub >=1.31.0,<3.0.0
        - filelock >=4.2.1,<5.0.0
        - fsspec >=2023.5.0,<2027.0.0
        - more-itertools >=10.0.0
        # Lower bound relaxed from upstream's >=2.0.0 for IsaacSim 5.1 compat,
        # whose isaacsim-kernel package pins numpy==1.26.0; no numpy 2.0-only
        # API is used by lerobot itself.
        - numpy >=1.26.0
        - einops >=0.8.0,<0.9.0
        - py-opencv >=4.9.0
        - pillow >=10.0.0,<14.0.0
        - requests >=2.32.0,<3.0.0
        - safetensors >=0.4.3,<1.0.0
        - tqdm >=4.66.0,<5.0.0
        - packaging >=24.2,<27.0
        - draccus >=0.11.6,<0.12.0
        - gymnasium >=1.1.1,<2.0.0
        - termcolor >=2.4.0,<4.0.0
        - pytorch >=2.7,<2.16.0
        # torchvision is strictly bound in PyPI metadata as it is ABI
        # constrained but this is not reflected in their PyPI metadata; as
        # conda-forge this ABI constraint is reflected, we can relax the
        # version constraint here
        - torchvision >=0.22.0

    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lerobot
          pip_check: true
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

  - package:
      name: lerobot-all
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-dataset', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-lancedb', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-training', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-hardware', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-viz', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-dynamixel', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-feetech', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-damiao', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-robstride', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-gamepad', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-hopejr', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-lekiwi', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-openarms', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-kinematics', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-intelrealsense', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-diffusion', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-multi-task-dit', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-wallx', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-wall-oss-05', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-pi', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-dm05', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-fineart-vla', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-molmoact2', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-smolvla', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-fastwam', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-longwam', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-flux3', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-groot', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-xvla', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-evo1', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-vla-jepa', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-lingbot-va', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-lingbot-vla-v2', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-g05', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-lawam', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-cosmos3', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-remote', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-dev', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-test', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-video-benchmark', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-aloha', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-pusht', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-sarm', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-robometer', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-topreward', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-peft', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lerobot
          pip_check: false
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

  # The tests files are non-neglibile in size, so we put them in a separate package
  - package:
      name: lerobot-tests
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot-all', exact=True) }}

    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - lerobot
          python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
      - files:
          source:
            - tests/**
        requirements:
          run:
            - pytest
            - python ${{ python_min }}.*
        script:
          - python -c "import compileall, pathlib, lerobot; assert compileall.compile_dir(str(pathlib.Path(lerobot.__file__).parent), quiet=1)"
          - python -c "from lerobot.datasets.lance_backend import _opened, batched; assert _opened(1) == 1 and list(batched(range(5), 2)) == [(0, 1), (2, 3), (4,)]"
          - python -c "from lerobot.transport.zenoh import BoundedSubscriber; queue = BoundedSubscriber[int](1); assert queue._offer(3) and queue.get() == 3"
          - if: linux
            then: export MUJOCO_GL="egl"
          # Workaround for https://github.com/conda-forge/gymnasium-feedstock/pull/50#issuecomment-3218125344
          - if: aarch64
            then: export LD_PRELOAD=libGLdispatch.so.0
          # Ensure that pygame tests pass on unix,
          # see https://github.com/conda-forge/gymnasium-feedstock/pull/36#issuecomment-2124699477
          - if: unix
            then:
              - export SDL_VIDEODRIVER="dummy"
              - export LEROBOT_TEST_DEVICE="cpu"
            else: set LEROBOT_TEST_DEVICE=cpu
          - python -m pytest -v -m "not gpu" --timeout=60 ${{ representative_tests }}

  - package:
      name: lerobot-pygame-dep
    requirements:
      host:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
      run:
        - python >=${{ python_min }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('lerobot', exact=True) }}
        - pygame >=2.5.1,<2.7.0
    tests:
      - script:
          - echo "tested in lerobot-tests"

  - package:

    requirements:
      host:
